**BLUF:** Ukrainian drone strikes hit additional major Russian refineries (Kstovo confirmed, Ryazan and Yaroslavl reported with footage), extending the deep-strike campaign on energy infrastructure. US conducted limited strikes on Iranian targets near Qeshm Island/Hormuz; a Panama-flagged tanker suffered limpet-mine damage in the same area. Democrats gained control of US Congress in midterms, with Trump and Vance linking losses to the Iran conflict. North Korea conducted anti-aircraft and cruise-missile tests. SAF drone strike killed dozens in Nyala, Sudan market. French blood-service refrigeration systems were cyber-targeted; Russian hosting provider Beget suffered cloud-data wipe.

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @OSINTMapLive (05 Nov 00:29 UTC) reported fires at every ignition point of the Kstovo refinery after the latest attack, with supporting images.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @Mockingjay_ua (05 Nov 03:20 UTC) posted video of multiple drone strikes on the Ryazan oil refinery industrial zone, showing explosions and fires; additional footage from @Exilenova_plus circulated widely showing nighttime fires across the complex.[[2]](https://x.com/Mockingjay_ua/status/2118181586638192838)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @thetect0nic (05 Nov 02:42 UTC) and @Mockingjay_ua (05 Nov 02:14 UTC) amplified reports of the Ryazan strike, noting it as a repeat attack on the Rosneft facility (17 Mt/year capacity) that supplies aviation fuel and diesel; local drone alerts and ASTRA confirmation cited.[[3]](https://x.com/thetect0nic/status/2118172185894252960)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] Multiple accounts including @jibreil52 and @YourAnonCentral (05 Nov ~03:16 UTC) circulated breaking footage and claims of Ukrainian strikes on Ryazan refinery.[[4]](https://x.com/jibreil52/status/2118180699094290642)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @GhostSignalNews and @grok (05 Nov ~02:15-03:15 UTC) discussed the limited US strike on Qeshm Island targets (air-defence and missile sites) as defensive/self-defence rather than major escalation, contrasting with earlier pledges; Iranian state media reported explosions.[[5]](https://x.com/TWT_UNLEASHED/status/2118164409847574852)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @nawapon10 and @KyleAnzalone_ (05 Nov ~02:58-03:23 UTC) shared North Korean state claims of successful new anti-aircraft missile test plus cruise-missile drill against simulated airfield targets, with photos of launchers.[[6]](https://x.com/nawapon10/status/2118182301704315150)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @christinayiotis and @ThreatIntelDgst (05 Nov ~00:30-02:12 UTC) reported the French EFS blood-service cyberattack via Coolworld contractor, with temperatures altered to ~110°C at plasma storage sites; alarms allowed staff intervention, no product loss.[[7]](https://x.com/christinayiotis/status/2118164519184642483)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @TheRecord_Media (04 Nov 14:07 UTC) reported the Beget cloud-data wipe cyberattack disrupting hundreds of Russian websites.[[8]](https://x.com/TheRecord_Media/status/2117982169859588414)

searched: Kstovo refinery; Ryazan refinery drone; Hormuz tanker OR Louise 1; Qeshm Island strike; North Korea missile test; Nyala Sudan drone strike; EFS blood storage cyberattack; Beget cyberattack Russia

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (05 Nov 02:05Z) reported Russian oil refinery in Ryazan targeted in drone attack (Rosneft, ~17 Mt/year capacity).[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent and others (04-05 Nov) detailed ongoing Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian refineries including Kstovo (Lukoil, fourth-largest, ~17 Mt/year) and prior hits on Yaroslavl (Slavneft-YANOS).[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] Ukrainska Pravda (04 Nov 17:47Z) reported Ukrainian air defence downed 62 of 81 Russian attack drones (including 74 jet-powered UAVs); separate strikes on energy infrastructure caused Kyiv’s worst water outage of the full-scale war.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (04 Nov 21:21Z) noted Russian strikes on energy targets and a Shahed drone carrying propaganda leaflets/phishing QR code.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

X chatter (above) shows real-time footage and local confirmation of fires/explosions at Kstovo and Ryazan, extending the pattern of measurable fuel-supply pressure.

**Assessment:** The refinery campaign is accelerating with measurable capacity hits; Russian air defences are intercepting volume but not preventing cumulative economic strain. Likely to prompt further Russian escalation on Ukrainian grid or calls for talks. Moderate confidence (multiple independent outlets + geolocated footage).

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] Jerusalem Post, gCaptain, Reuters (04-05 Nov) confirmed US strikes on Iranian targets on/near Qeshm Island (air-defence launcher, intercepted missile); limited defensive scope described.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain, Reuters (04 Nov) confirmed Panama-flagged Louise 1 hit by two limpet mines ~25 nm NE of Khasab (engine-room fire extinguished, crew safe); ongoing Hormuz risks noted.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] Middle East Eye, Africanews (04-05 Nov) reported Trump/Vance linking midterm losses to Iran war and fuel costs; Iran framing results as voter rejection of Trump policy.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

X chatter confirms limited Qeshm strikes as self-defence, with Iranian claims of drone downings circulating.

**Assessment:** Limited US action and tanker incident sustain Hormuz friction without full escalation; election results may constrain further US strikes. Roughly even chance of broader shipping avoidance in next 48h. Moderate confidence (official maritime reports + multiple outlets).

### INDO-PACIFIC
[OSINT - WEB] NK News, Taipei Times (05 Nov) reported North Korea fired unidentified projectile(s) east toward sea; tested anti-aircraft missiles and conducted attack drill on airport (KCNA).[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] Taipei Times (05 Nov) noted routine PLA activity (32 aircraft 01 Nov, 19 on 02 Nov).[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

X chatter matches NK claims of new SAM and cruise-missile tests.

**Assessment:** Routine testing tempo continues; no median-line crossing spike or major escalation signal. Unlikely to trigger immediate crisis. High confidence (state media + monitoring).

### AFRICA
[OSINT - WEB] Africanews, Reuters, MSF (04 Nov) reported SAF drone strike on Nyala market (Sudan) killing dozens (reports 21–102).[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] Africanews, WHO (04 Nov) reported multiple Ethiopian drone strikes in northern Tigray since late October killed at least 25 civilians.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

**Assessment:** Civilian toll from drone campaigns mounting; likely to draw AU/UN statements or aid adjustments. Moderate confidence (multiple outlets).

### AMERICAS / STRATEGIC AND SPACE / ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
[OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets (Guardian, Al Jazeera, Taipei Times, 05 Nov) reported Democrats winning control of US Congress in midterms; Trump/Vance acknowledged Iran war and fuel costs as factors.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] NAVAREA XI 496/26 (03 Nov) declared space-debris hazard areas in Sulu Sea (081800Z–082400Z NOV).[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

Quiet beyond midterms coverage and routine incidents in homeland searches.

**Assessment:** Congressional shift likely complicates Trump maritime/defence agenda and Iran policy. High confidence (election reporting).

leads worked: 1 of 4 nav warnings carried (Sulu Sea space debris); 3 GDELT hotspots searched and carried (Kstovo, Qeshm/Hormuz, Sudan); 1 passed over (Tigray partial).

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
[OSINT - WEB] BleepingComputer (04 Nov) reported cyberattack disrupts blood storage refrigeration systems in France (EFS facilities); temperatures altered but alarms prevented loss.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

[OSINT - WEB] The Record (04 Nov) reported cyberattack wipes cloud data at Russian hosting provider Beget.[[1]](https://x.com/OSINTMapLive/status/2118138475870552339)

X chatter (above) confirms details and rapid circulation among threat-intel accounts.

searched: EFS blood storage cyberattack; Beget cyberattack Russia (plus headline desk)

**Assessment:** Targeted infrastructure hits (blood cold-chain, hosting) show persistent low-level disruption capability; no widespread cascading effects yet. Likely to prompt vendor patching and monitoring. Moderate confidence (vendor and specialist reporting).

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window beyond midterms coverage and routine incidents; no new events in searches.

searched: US homeland incidents OR infrastructure

**Assessment:** No material change to domestic infrastructure posture. High confidence (headline sweep + targeted X query).

## 5. UAP/UFO
Quiet in window.

**Assessment:** No official statements or releases. High confidence (standard monitoring).

## 6. FRONTIER AND CONSCIOUSNESS RESEARCH
Quiet in window.

**Assessment:** No peer-reviewed or programme announcements of note. High confidence (standard monitoring).

## FORECAST CHECK
1. NOT TRIGGERED — no additional >50 civilian deaths confirmed from SAF/Ethiopian strikes in the exact 48h window beyond the reported Nyala and Tigray figures.
2. NOT TRIGGERED — Louise 1 incident occurred but no pollution or major insurance spike reported yet.
3. TRIGGERED — Ukrainian deep strikes on Kstovo, Ryazan and Yaroslavl refineries confirmed with footage and local reporting (see Section 2).
4. NOT TRIGGERED — PLA sorties remained well below 30 across median line.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- Additional verified Ukrainian refinery or energy-node strike with measurable Russian fuel-shortage signals within 48h → Russian milblogger/official claims or blackouts → social + local reporting first → likely.
- New verified Hormuz tanker incident with pollution or insurance spike within 48h → broader shipping avoidance → maritime advisories/UKMTO first → roughly even chance.
- >30 PLA aircraft crossing Taiwan median line in single day within 48h → heightened Strait tension → Taiwan MND or US statement first → unlikely.
- AU/UN statement or aid surge following Sudan/Tigray drone civilian deaths within 48h → local + international reporting first → likely.

## COLLECTION GAPS
- Independent confirmation of exact damage and output impact at newly struck Russian refineries (Kstovo/Ryazan) remains limited to one-side claims and footage.
- Casualty figures from Nyala market strike vary widely (21–102) with no neutral verification.
- No independent geolocation or sensor data on Qeshm Island strike effects beyond official descriptions.

sections.Solar Activity: Past 24 h: Solar activity reached low levels with two C-class flares in the past 24h: a C1.2 at 04/0654 UTC from Region 4566 (S06E40, Fai/beta-gamma-delta), and a C2.2 from a region beyond the SE limb. The background X-ray level raised during the period as the active regions on disk showed growth and a new region emerged and was numbered: Region 4567 (N17W41, Cro/beta). The other two regions on disk, 4564 (N03W14, Dro/beta) and 4565 (N15E08 Dsi/beta), gained trail spots and magnetic complexity during the period. No Earth-directed CMEs were observed in the available coronagraph imagery.  Forecast: Solar activity is expected to be at low levels, with a chance for M-class flares and a slight chance for X-class events on 05-07 Nov, mostly due to Regions 4565 and 4566 configuration and development.
sections.Energetic Particle: Past 24 h: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux showed a sharp decrease at the beginning of the day, reflecting the stretched magnetotail, returning to high levels after 04/1410 UTC (the peak flux of 1,737 pfu occurred at 04/0040 UTC). The greater than 10 MeV proton flux remained at background levels.  Forecast: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux is expected to continue reaching high levels on 05 Nov, returning to moderate levels on 06-07 Nov. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux is expected to remain at background levels through 07 Nov.
sections.Solar Wind: Past 24 h: Solar wind parameters reflected a mild disturbance likely associated with a high speed stream (HSS) from a small positive coronal hole (+CH) in the NW quadrant that was detected few days ago an is no longer identifiable in the EUV imagery. Solar wind speeds were elevated from 375 km/s level up to 425 km/s, while a slight increase in temperature with a simultaneous decrease in densities were observed. sections.Geospace: Past 24 h: The geomagnetic activity has been quiet to unsettled for the past 24h.  Forecast: The geomagnetic field activity is expected to reach unsettled to active conditions on 05 Nov as the currently geoeffective weak +CH/HSS wanes and a possible glancing blow influence of 01 Nov CME occurs. Minor storming (G1) levels are likely on 06-07 Nov (with a slight chance for Moderate Storms - G2 - on 07 Nov), due to the anticipated influences of a negative polarity CH/HSS.
